bio.text: Blake Johnson, a Republican from Corning, represents Arkansas Senate District 21, which includes all of Clay, Greene and Randolph counties and the northeast part of Lawrence County.
He was elected to the Senate in 2014 and took the oath of office on the first day of the 2015 session; in the 95th General Assembly (2025) he was Senate Majority Leader.
Johnson is a farmer and served as an alderman in Corning before his election to the Senate.
He was born in Poplar Bluff, Missouri, and graduated from Arkansas State University.
